title: geanthus brevilabris
intro: Geanthus brevilabris, commonly known as the Yellow Formosa Peony, is a flowering plant species. As a medicinal plant, it has been used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Geanthus brevilabris include its ability to relieve pain and reduce inflammation, making it a valuable plant for treating conditions such as arthritis and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of Geanthus brevilabris include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
